# AudioNotch

> AudioNotch provides personalized notched sound therapy for tinnitus treatment through web and mobile applications, combined with free clinical assessment tools and hearing tests.

AudioNotch is a comprehensive platform for tinnitus management that combines evidence-based notched sound therapy with interactive hearing assessment tools. The service uses Web Audio API technology and supports multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and mobile platforms (iOS, Android) to deliver personalized audio therapy based on individual tinnitus frequency matching.

## Tinnitus Frequency & Pitch Matching Tools

- [Tinnitus Frequency Matcher](https://audionotch.com/tinnitus-frequency-matcher): Enhanced tool for accurate tinnitus frequency matching and detection
- [Tuning Guide](https://audionotch.com/tuning-guide): Comprehensive guide to matching tinnitus pitch for notched sound therapy
- [Tuner and Tone Generator](https://audionotch.com/app/tune): Free online tuner and tone generator for tinnitus pitch matching and therapy
- [Tinnitus Masker](https://audionotch.com/tinnitus-masker): Free tinnitus masking sounds and conversion to notched therapy
- [Pulsatile Tinnitus Generator](https://audionotch.com/pulsatile-tinnitus-generator): Sound generator for pulsatile tinnitus and ear clicking with pitch and BPM matching

## Hearing Assessment & Testing Tools

- [Free Online Hearing Test](https://audionotch.com/hearing-test): Free online hearing test with audiogram using pure-tone audiometry
- [Extended High-Frequency Hearing Test](https://audionotch.com/extended-high-frequency-test): Extended high-frequency hearing test from 8-20 kHz with age comparisons
- [Speech-in-Noise Test](https://audionotch.com/speech-in-noise-test): Clinically validated speech-in-noise hearing test using Digits-in-Noise protocol
- [Tinnitus Handicap Inventory (THI) Test](https://audionotch.com/tinnitus-handicap-inventory): Clinically validated THI test for tinnitus severity assessment
- [Ear Age Test](https://audionotch.com/ear-age-test): Free ear age test measuring high-frequency hearing in browser
- [Hearing Loss Simulator](https://audionotch.com/hearing-loss-simulator): Interactive hearing loss simulator with preset profiles and custom audiograms
